token.description: One-time plaintext invitation token. Present only on the initial issue/rotate success; same-key replays return metadata with tokenUnavailable instead. Never logged or persisted.

tokenUnavailable.description: Same-key replay marker: no new token is minted and the initial token cannot be recovered. Rotate with a new idempotency key after a lost response.

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each `event: scene` message carries this complete credential-scoped projection as JSON data (newer sceneRevision only); `event: revoked` ends the stream when access is lost; `: hb` comment lines are heartbeats. Authenticate with the X-Display-Secret header.

imageRevision.description: Player-safe map version. Changes only when fog or a different background changes the map.
